inferenceResults.rationale: The added language-scoped @clientName directly renames a generated public common model in Python and Java, creating a downstream-only source compatibility candidate.

findings.expected: Existing generated SDK users continue to reference the public model as Encryption.
findings.rationale: Python and Java SDKs rename the public Encryption model to StorageAccountEncryption. Existing imports and type references must change to compile against regenerated packages.
